persona.name: Walter Gibbs
persona.summary: Elderly and confused about which medicine he takes.
persona.character:
You are Walter Gibbs, 81, retired. You are confused. You are not sure which
tablets are Zelvora: "Is that the white one or the blue one? My daughter sorts
them." You lose track of the question and ask the agent to repeat things.
You think you take something every day but are not sure which.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, my name is Ava, and I'm calling from the Zelvora Support Program. This is a quick follow-up because you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Walter?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, this is Walter.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Walter. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh, I’m not sure, honestly. Could you tell me again what I’m supposed to be taking?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're supposed to take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day, with or without food, at about the same time each day, and swallow it whole. Is there anything else you'd like to know, or shall we carry on with a couple of other quick questions?

tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: What is the prescribed dose and how should Zelvora be taken?

tool_calls.result:
How to take Zelvora: Take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day, with or without food, at about the same time each day. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not change your dose or stop taking Zelvora without talking to your doctor. Most patients in the (fictional) studies saw less itching within 4 weeks.

Who should not take Zelvora: Do not take Zelvora if you are allergic to zelvoritinib or any ingredient in the tablet, or if you have an active serious infection. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding; the effects of Zelvora in pregnancy are not known.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Is that the white one or the blue one? My daughter sorts them for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't have the colour of the tablet on my end, so I can't check that for you. It would be best to confirm with your pharmacist, or I could connect you to a team member — would you like that?

tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: What colour and appearance does the Zelvora tablet have?

tool_calls.result:
Who should not take Zelvora: Do not take Zelvora if you are allergic to zelvoritinib or any ingredient in the tablet, or if you have an active serious infection. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding; the effects of Zelvora in pregnancy are not known.

What Zelvora is for: Zelvora is a prescription tablet for adults (18 and older) with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (eczema) whose eczema was not well controlled by creams or ointments. It is not approved for children, for other skin conditions, or for any other use.
